about:
We Are More is a locally owned and operated technology integration firm based in Lahaina, Hawaii, on the island of Maui. The company was established in 1984 and has served the Hawaiian islands — including the Big Island, Maui County, Oahu, and Kauai — for decades.

The firm consults, designs, manufactures, installs, and manages a broad range of smart systems for homes, businesses, and marine vessels. Its service portfolio spans acoustical treatment, telecommunications, security, solar, Wi‑Fi and cable networking, voice‑over‑IP, computer networks, network security, home theater, digital signage, lighting, automated locks, shades, blinds, SCADA, and energy monitoring and automation. We Are More holds a Hawaii contractor’s license (C‑35167), a CAGE code (81P78), and is a registered DOE vendor (149246), enabling it to work on city, county, state, and federal projects.

Customers range from residential homeowners seeking smart‑home automation to commercial clients needing integrated security, AV, and IT infrastructure, as well as government agencies at the military, federal, and state levels. The company also serves the marine sector with electronics and automation for vessels.

We Are More emphasizes supplying “the right products for the right reasons” so clients can focus on core activities, and offers financing options to ease project adoption.
